tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Full market report for one US city or metro. Example: city='Austin', state='TX' returns Austin's median price, appreciation, rental yield, momentum and migration.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description:
List the US markets this server can report on, optionally filtered
to one state.
Example: state='TX'

tools.name: get_market_health
tools.description:
Investment health score (1-10) for a US market, with a label
(Strong Buy / Favorable / Neutral / Caution / Avoid) and the signals behind it.
Example: city='Tampa', state='FL'

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description:
Compare two US markets side by side, with a winner marked on price,
yield and appreciation. Requires API key (Investor plan) — https://www.lotlytics.us/pricing ; key at
https://www.lotlytics.us/settings/api-keys
Example: city_a='Austin', state_a='TX', city_b='Nashville', state_b='TN'

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description:
Rank US markets by investment criteria; no filters returns the
top-ranked markets nationally. Requires API key (Investor plan) — https://www.lotlytics.us/pricing ;
key at https://www.lotlytics.us/settings/api-keys
Example: state='TX', max_price=300000, min_rental_yield=6

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_summary" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Get a real estate market summary for a US city or metro area.
Returns median home price, appreciation, rental yield, market momentum, and migration trends.
Free tier: top 50 markets. With API key: all 894 US metros.
Use get_market_health first for a quick score, then this for the full picture." → after: "Full market report for one US city or metro. Example: city='Austin', state='TX' returns Austin's median price, appreciation, rental yield, momentum and migration."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
